Answer · Authagonal cost by MAU (no SSO)

10k users: $149/mo on Scale · 50k users: $339/mo on Enterprise · 100k users: $339/mo on Enterprise.

  • 1k users · no SSO: Starter at $29/mo ranks #20 of 33, $348/yr more than Clerk Hobby.
  • 10k users · 1 SSO: Scale at $149/mo ranks #16 of 25, $1,788/yr more than Auth0 Free (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection).
  • 50k users · 5 SSO: Enterprise at $339/mo ranks #5 (tied) of 18, $3,897/yr more than Firebase Auth / Identity Platform Pay as you go (Firebase Auth / Identity Platform’s SSO assumes 200 SSO users per connection).
  • 100k users · 10 SSO: Enterprise at $339/mo ranks #3 of 18, $3,417/yr more than Supabase Auth Pro (platform) (Supabase Auth’s SSO assumes 200 SSO users per connection).

As of 2026-11-07, from 34 verified plan rows. SSO users: Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, not per connection (first 50 free, then $0.015 per SSO user a month). Their SSO results here assume 200 SSO users per connection (5 connections = 1,000 SSO users). See how 1,000 or 2,000 per connection changes the result or set your own. B2B: every SSO result assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection (members = its SSO users, 200 by default). Published org caps and fees are applied, e.g. Clerk’s $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on above 20 members or 100 orgs, Auth0 Free’s 5-org cap, Descope $1/tenant over 35; plans over a cap are left out. Authagonal pricing FAQ

How much does Authagonal cost at 10k, 50k and 100k users?

10k users: $149/mo on Scale; 50k users: $339/mo on Enterprise; 100k users: $339/mo on Enterprise. Cheapest verified Authagonal plan, monthly USD list price, no SSO, from https://authagonal.io/pricing (checked 2026-11-07).

How does Authagonal count billable users?

Authagonal bills by MAU: Active users = unique users who log in at least once in the billing month (including SCIM-provisioned). Plans differ by user limit and support; every plan includes SAML SSO, SCIM, MFA, custom domains and branding.

Does Authagonal charge for SCIM / Directory Sync?

Free: Included, no per-connection SCIM fee printed. Starter: Included, no per-connection SCIM fee printed. Pro: Included, no per-connection SCIM fee printed. Scale: Included, no per-connection SCIM fee printed. Enterprise: Included, no per-connection SCIM fee printed.

Answers are computed from the ledger rows above; last read 2026-11-07.
